# WooF Dogs

> Professional dog training serving South Florida — Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Wellington, West Palm Beach, Loxahatchee & surrounding areas.

## About

WooF Dogs is a professional dog training company based in Loxahatchee, FL, serving Palm Beach County and surrounding South Florida communities. We use positive, science-based training methods tailored to each dog's temperament and learning style. All training programs begin with a professional behavioral evaluation. Services are available in-home, at our training facility, or virtually.

- [About WooF Dogs](https://woofdogs.com/about): Meet Shay Maimoni—former IDF K9 trainer with 30+ years experience. WooF Dogs serves Palm Beach County with science-based obedience, service dog, and behavior training.

## Services

- [Professional Behavioral Evaluation](https://woofdogs.com/evaluation): Comprehensive assessment of your dog's temperament, skills, and needs with personalized training recommendations. The first step for all training programs.
- [Obedience Training](https://woofdogs.com/obedience): Professional obedience training for dogs of all ages and skill levels. In-home and bootcamp options available.
- [Puppy Training](https://woofdogs.com/puppy-training): VIP puppy training program with age-appropriate curriculum. Build a strong foundation for your puppy's development.
- [Board & Train Bootcamp](https://woofdogs.com/bootcamp): Intensive board and train program. Your dog stays with our trainers for accelerated learning and behavior transformation.
- [Aggression Management](https://woofdogs.com/aggression-management): Professional behavior modification for reactive and aggressive dogs. Safety-first approach with in-home and intensive rehabilitation options.
- [Service Animal Training](https://woofdogs.com/service-animal-training): Specialized service dog training with task-specific and public access training. Professional certification preparation.
- [Therapy Dog Training](https://woofdogs.com/therapy-dog): Professional therapy dog certification training. AKC Canine Good Citizen preparation and temperament assessment.
- [Dog Boarding](https://woofdogs.com/dog-boarding): Professional dog boarding services in South Florida. Safe, comfortable boarding facilities with premium accommodations, 24/7 supervision, experienced staff, and optional board & train upgrades.
